translations.web: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
translations.bsb: He stretches out the north over empty space; He hangs the earth upon nothing.
translations.kjv: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
translations.asv: He stretcheth out the north over empty space, And hangeth the earth upon nothing.
